propositions: GitHub Code Quality preview findings require mechanical remediation of 31 low-risk, no-behavior-change violations across Python and JavaScript code
File-not-closed violations require wrapping open() calls in context managers across multiple modules
Unnecessary-lambda and repeated-import violations require replacing inline callables and removing redundant local imports
SIM115 ruff rule should be enabled to prevent future file-not-closed violations
All 31 fixes must pass linting, testing, and code review gates before merge to main
